explication: TripoSR reconstructs a textured or vertex-colored 3D asset from one image. A CLI or Gradio user submits an image, which is validated and preprocessed, optionally with background removal. The system tokenizes the image, runs the configured reconstruction backbone, and produces scene codes. Those codes drive NeRF rendering and marching-cubes mesh extraction. Optional texture baking queries the renderer over an atlas, while the CLI and UI export meshes, textures, or rendered videos. Some configured model stages are only evidenced through dynamic wiring in tsr/system.py.
